text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: coordinating and resumptive connector that adds this confession to the continuing jinn testimony

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following content particle with first-person plural suffix

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the confession to the running jinn testimony rather than opening a detached reflection. Its light proclitic form leans into {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}), so the ayah begins already attached to what preceded, and the later uncertainty is filed as another item in the same evidentiary sequence. The sound then moves quickly into the doubled n of {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}), making the collective speaker audible at the boundary.

topics.headline: continuation inside jinn testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ignorance statement is part of the same testimony sequence, not an isolated aside.
topics.reason: The opening connector coordinates and resumes the prior speech, so it carries the blocked-heaven report into the present confession.

topics.headline: proclitic boundary fused to clause body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the boundary marker is formally lightweight but syntactically unavoidable because it attaches directly to the clause.
topics.reason: The single-letter proclitic has no independent clause body and is written/pronounced with the following content unit.

topics.headline: nasal cadence into collective confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector move immediately into the collective marker of the confession.
topics.reason: The local sound sequence links the opening connector to the doubled n of the first-person plural particle.

words.gloss_range: content particle plus first-person plural suffix, keeping the confession inside reported speech while identifying the speaking collective

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted variant opening with emphatic independent force

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) packages the confession as reported content and gives it a collective subject in the same surface unit. The accepted {{ar:وَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:wa-innā}}) reading sharpens the line toward direct emphatic testimony, while the aligned {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) keeps it dependent in the serial report; either way, the ignorance belongs to the speaking group, not to one exceptional interpreter. The fused particle and suffix make subordination and communal self-reference arrive together.

topics.headline: embedded confession with variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reading variation affects whether the confession sounds embedded or emphatically direct, while the collective confession remains stable.
topics.reason: The aligned surface is governed as reported content, but the accepted kasra variant marks a real register contrast without changing the first-person plural ownership.

topics.headline: plural suffix assigns shared epistemic limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-knowledge is owned by the whole speaking collective rather than by a lone observer.
topics.reason: The suffix identifies the continuing first-person plural speakers and makes them the bearers of the epistemic stance.

topics.headline: particle and pronoun compressed into one testimony unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that clause introduction and self-reference are compressed into the formula that extends the jinn deposition.
topics.reason: The form combines the content particle with the plural suffix and echoes the serialized testimony shape in the surrounding speech.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired interrogative alternative frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) sets the ayah inside present non-knowledge before any option is named. It is not the past-bound negation of {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) or the emphatic future impossibility of {{ar:لَنْ}} ({{tr:lan}}); it marks current lack of access. Because it stands before {{ar:نَدْرِىٓ}} ({{tr:nadrī}}), the whole {{ar:أَ...أَمْ}} ({{tr:a...am}}) alternative remains under confessed ignorance rather than becoming two asserted verdicts.

topics.headline: present negation of cognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers confess current non-access, not merely a past failure or a future impossibility.
topics.reason: The negator governs the imperfect cognition verb; comparison with other negators is useful only to narrow the local force to present non-knowledge.

topics.headline: negation holds both branches open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harm and guidance are hypotheses contained inside a confessed limit, not claims the speakers know.
topics.reason: The negated cognition clause governs the embedded alternative question, so the disjunction remains interpretive and unresolved.

topics.headline: separate negator makes the limit visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the negation before the cognition verb rather than discovering polarity only after the verb.
topics.reason: The particle is a separate word before the verb, with a brief-to-lengthened cadence into {{ar:نَدْرِىٓ}} ({{tr:nadrī}}).

words.gloss_range: negated imperfect first-person plural cognition verb, expressing ongoing collective inability to discern divine intent
words.root_gloss_range: locally functioning as the d-r-y knowing/discerning field despite the bundle root normalization; the active payoff is discerned access withheld
words.prose: {{ar:نَدْرِىٓ}} ({{tr:nadrī}}) makes the speakers remain inside ongoing collective non-knowledge. The verb is imperfect and first plural, so the group can report the guarded-heaven sign but cannot discern whether it means harm or right guidance. Its cognition field is more about finding out or gaining interpretive access than about abstract possession of information; negation blocks that access. The prolonged final sound lets the confession linger before the question opens, and the same d-r-y knowledge-limit pattern later returns in 72:25.

topics.headline: imperfect plural non-knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ignorance is ongoing and communal even without a separate subject pronoun.
topics.reason: The imperfect first-person plural morphology supplies the continuing group subject and keeps the knowledge problem open.

topics.headline: discerned access rather than bare knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers lack interpretive access to the sign they can observe, not merely a stock fact.
topics.reason: The root/form evidence supports a knowing or finding-out field, but local negation makes the payoff withheld discernment rather than fulfilled disclosure.

topics.headline: cognition verb governs the alternative question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both later options are what the speakers cannot determine.
topics.reason: The verb takes the following {{ar:أَ...أَمْ}} ({{tr:a...am}}) question as its clausal complement.

topics.headline: local d-r-y pattern of bounded access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this confession belongs to a wider Quranic and same-surah pattern of reserved knowledge (72:25).
topics.reason: The recurrence and formula evidence links this local non-knowledge with other d-r-y limit contexts, including the later same-surah confession at 72:25.

topics.headline: lengthened final vowel slows the confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the non-knowledge held before the alternatives arrive.
topics.reason: The final prolongation mark belongs to the cognition verb and delays the transition into the question.

topics.headline: visible surveillance becomes hidden intent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from sensory encounter with the guarded boundary to inability to interpret divine purpose.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence supports a transition from visible heavenly obstruction to confessed uncertainty about its meaning.

words.gloss_range: interrogative first alternative, an indefinite feared harm fronted before the passive verb and held under inquiry

words.prose: {{ar:أَشَرٌّ}} ({{tr:a-sharrun}}) enters as the first questioned pole, not as an assertion. The prefixed interrogative and tanwīn make harm a queried, unspecified possibility, while fronting lets the feared outcome be heard before {{ar:أُرِيدَ}} ({{tr:urīda}}) and before any agent can appear. Its opposition to {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}) makes the danger sound like loss of right direction, not only pain, and the ayah later lets the positive pole answer it from the final position. The rare compact form and doubled r give that feared pole a clipped, marked entry rather than routine negative vocabulary.

topics.headline: harm placed under inquiry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feared harm is grammatically questioned rather than asserted.
topics.reason: The interrogative prefix fuses with the noun and opens the first side of the governed alternative question.

topics.headline: fronted indefinite harm before agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outcome strikes first while its measure and source remain unnamed.
topics.reason: The nominative indefinite noun is fronted before the passive verb, keeping harm central and unspecified before agency is withheld.

topics.headline: evil opposed to right direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negative pole is framed against right-directedness, so evil appears as misdirection and breakdown.
topics.reason: The semantic contrast is local: {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}) is paired with {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}), and the final word returns the positive pole.

topics.headline: rare compact harsh entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the negative term as a compact marked entry rather than routine filler.
topics.reason: The rarity/form evidence and doubled consonant support markedness and clipped acoustic pressure without changing the local interrogative role.

topics.headline: first branch depends on prior non-knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the feared option inside the carried confession frame instead of treating it as free speculation.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence ties the {{ar:أَ...أَمْ}} ({{tr:a...am}}) pair to the preceding {{ar:لَا نَدْرِىٓ}} ({{tr:lā nadrī}}) frame.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect passive of willing, presenting possible harmful intention as purposeful but agent-suppressed

words.prose: {{ar:أُرِيدَ}} ({{tr:urīda}}) makes the feared branch purposeful without naming a willer. The perfect passive treats possible harm as a complete willed state, but the agent is suppressed, unlike the later active {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) with {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}). That voice contrast is the main payoff: harm remains grammatically real and aimed, yet less personally anchored than the guidance branch. The passive choice is marked against the broader active-willing field, and the repeated r-w-d forms make the contrast audible as well as syntactic.

topics.headline: purposeful harm with source withheld
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the harmful possibility is not random, but its source is deliberately left unnamed.
topics.reason: The passive Form IV verb suppresses the agent while making {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}) the exposed patient/outcome.

topics.headline: perfect aspect with directed volition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fear concerns an intended adverse purpose, not accidental cosmic disturbance.
topics.reason: The perfect aspect and r-w-d volition field preserve directed aim, while passive voice limits agency assignment.

topics.headline: passive harm versus active Lord-guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two alternatives are balanced in question form but not symmetrical in agency.
topics.reason: The local repetition of the will-root shifts from passive to active, giving guidance an explicit subject while harm remains deagentivized.

topics.headline: rare passive against active-will field

words.prose: {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) attaches the possible harmful intention to an affected target while keeping that target open: whoever, or those who, are in the earth. The bāʾ gives direction or concern, and {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) refuses a named class. Because preposition and relative are fused, the affected population enters as a governed target rather than as an independent subject. This open relative later tightens into {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}), so the same population moves from broad scope to pronominal focus across the two branches.

topics.headline: open relative as affected party
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possible harm concerns an open animate population rather than a named faction.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative pronoun and marks the target of intention while the relative form keeps identity open.

topics.headline: preposition and relative fused as one governed unit

topics.reason: The later {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}) resumes the same population with repeated bāʾ and plural pronoun.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) locates the affected group inside the terrestrial domain, not merely on a surface. It governs {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) and completes the open {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) phrase as earth-inhabitants. The preposition is small, but it turns the question from an abstract cosmic interpretation into concern for beings embedded within the earth realm.

topics.headline: containment rather than surface placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the affected beings are pictured inside the earth-domain, not simply standing on ground.
topics.reason: The local preposition governs the definite earth noun and licenses both spatial containment and domain force.

topics.headline: preposition depends on its earth complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the locative relation as a phrase that completes the open relative target.
topics.reason: The particle cannot stand alone; it pulls the following definite noun into a continuous governed phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive earth-domain governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), the recognized terrestrial arena of the question
words.root_gloss_range: land, ground, and earth-realm field; locally narrowed to the unified lower realm after the barred-heaven scene

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second-branch pronoun phrase resuming earth-dwellers
locative preposition governing the earth noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is the definite genitive complement of {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so earth is the containing arena rather than the agent or object. The singular definite form gathers the lower realm into one recognized domain, not one local plot of land. After the guarded-heaven scene, the word redirects attention downward: the jinn cannot read what the barrier above means for those in the earth, and the same earth-domain remains in view when {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}) resumes the affected group. Its article links by hamzat-waṣl in the locative phrase, and the earth concern returns soon at 72:12.

topics.headline: recognized earth arena under fī
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is a definite containing arena, not a vague place-name or participant in the action.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), fixing it as the locative domain for the affected referents.

topics.headline: earth as lower cosmic pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from barred heaven (72:8-9) to concern for earth below.
topics.reason: The root can mean land or ground broadly, but local context after the heaven barrier narrows it to the terrestrial/lower-realm pole.

topics.headline: singular definite gathers the realm

topics.reason: The definite singular and common phrase profile support comprehensive terrestrial scope in this location.

topics.reason: The first branch locates {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) in earth, and the second branch resumes that group with {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}).

topics.headline: earth returns soon in the surah

topics.reason: The same root recurs shortly at 72:12, so the current earth-domain question is not isolated.

topics.headline: article joined by hamzat-waṣl

topics.reason: The hamzat-waṣl of the article links recitationally after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}).

words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) is the hinge that turns the first queried harm branch into a balanced whether-or question. It is not a loose {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}); it answers the opening interrogative and forces both possibilities to be weighed under {{ar:لَا نَدْرِىٓ}} ({{tr:lā nadrī}}). At the same time, its placement pivots the sentence from passive {{ar:أُرِيدَ}} ({{tr:urīda}}) to active {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), so the smallest connector marks the shift in agency.

topics.headline: paired a...am question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two branches are one disciplined alternative question, not two loose statements.
topics.reason: The connected particle completes the initial interrogative frame and keeps the semantic antithesis inside one governed question.

topics.headline: hinge from passive harm to active guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot from agentless harmful possibility to active Lord-centered guidance.
topics.reason: The particle stands between the passive harm clause and the active guidance clause, organizing the ayah as confession, harm alternative, and guidance alternative.

words.prose: {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) reverses the earlier passive. The active perfect prepares for the delayed subject {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) and gives the guidance branch a full semantic frame: who wills, for whom, and what outcome. The same r-w-d field still marks directed purpose, but here that purpose is anchored in a named Lord and aimed through {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}) toward {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}).

topics.headline: active perfect prepares named subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance receives an active willing verb with a named subject, unlike the harm branch.
topics.reason: The masculine singular active perfect agrees with the delayed subject and excludes the passive deagentivization of the first branch.

topics.headline: agent beneficiary and goal specified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive branch is semantically more complete than the feared branch.
topics.reason: The clause specifies the agent, the affected/benefited group, and the intended object of right guidance.

topics.headline: same will-root with opposite voice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated r-w-d forms force comparison: same will-field, different voice, different agency.
topics.reason: The local echo of {{ar:أُرِيدَ}} ({{tr:urīda}}) and {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) makes the agency asymmetry visible and audible.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) keeps the group from becoming a simple direct object of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}). With {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}), it marks those people as the party for whom and concerning whom right guidance is intended. Its repetition after {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) links both branches to the same population, while word order places the beneficiaries before {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}): the direction of care is heard before its named source.

topics.headline: bāʾ marks beneficiary and concern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is willed for and concerning the group, not merely decreed as an abstract object.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun after the will-verb and marks beneficiary/affected-party force rather than a direct object.

topics.headline: compact dependency before Lord-title

topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun fuse into one dependency, and the phrase precedes the delayed subject.

topics.headline: second bāʾ answers first branch target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repeated bāʾ links the two alternatives while open reference becomes pronoun.
topics.reason: The bāʾ of {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) returns in {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}), and the suffix sound begins the nearby him/hum relation.

words.prose: {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) resolves the earlier {{ar:مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:man fī al-arḍi}}) as a collective animate group. The masculine plural does not narrow the referent to males; it keeps the mixed or general collective available. Bound to {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), the pronoun makes the group beneficiaries or affected persons rather than agents, and its immediate echo in {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) thickens the guidance branch into a Lord-recipient relation.

topics.headline: plural suffix resolves open man collectively
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the open earth-dweller phrase becomes a definite collective target without excluding a mixed group.
topics.reason: The plural pronoun resumes the formally singular relative as a collective animate referent and personalizes it in the guidance branch.

topics.headline: suffix carried inside prepositional phrase

topics.headline: beneficiary and possessor suffix cluster

topics.reason: The adjacent {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) and {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) repeat the plural referent across beneficiary and possessor slots.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) is the delayed nominative subject of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), so the guidance branch receives explicit agency after the active verb. The construct with {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the title relationally definite: not a generic title, but their Lord, tied to the same group marked in {{ar:بِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bihim}}). The r-b-b field adds formative lordship, so {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}) sounds like cultivated right direction. This title also belongs to the surah’s repeated Lord-language, including 72:2, 72:3, 72:13, 72:17, 72:20, 72:25, and 72:28. The doubled b gives the title compressed acoustic weight among the surrounding pronoun particles.

topics.headline: explicit agent after active will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the good branch lands on a named agent while the harm branch never receives one.
topics.reason: The nominative noun is the delayed subject of the active will-verb, creating agency asymmetry with passive {{ar:أُرِيدَ}} ({{tr:urīda}}).

topics.headline: construct title tied to recipients

topics.reason: The construct noun with plural possessive suffix makes the title definite by relation and echoes the nearby beneficiary suffix.

topics.headline: rabb field makes guidance developmental

topics.reason: The r-b-b field includes sustaining, raising, training, and governing, while the local noun remains the stable subject of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}).

topics.headline: Lord-language local network

topics.reason: The supplied recurrence and pair data connect this word with the surah’s r-b-b thread and with guidance/earth fields.

topics.headline: doubled b gives the title weight

topics.reason: The shaddah on the b of the title gives the word a denser acoustic profile.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative verbal noun/object of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), naming right-directedness as the intended but unspecified outcome
words.root_gloss_range: rectitude, mature judgment, right course, and appropriated guidance; locally the terminal positive pole willed by their Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening negative pole answered by final rashadā

words.prose: {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}) is the accusative object and final landing of the ayah. It names the intended outcome of the active divine willing, but tanwīn leaves the concrete mode open: the speakers can name right-directedness without knowing how it will unfold. Its field is mature rectitude and right course, not merely information, and its final placement answers the opening {{ar:أَشَرٌّ}} ({{tr:a-sharrun}}) without erasing uncertainty. The same r-sh-d thread appears at 72:2, 72:14, and 72:21, so the closing word points into the surah’s larger guidance arc. After the prior heavenly blockage, this ending lets obstruction remain interpretable within a possible right-guidance frame.

topics.headline: right guidance as object of active will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that right guidance is the goal of the active willing, not just a condition around the people.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun is the direct object of {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}), with the Lord supplying the agent.

topics.headline: indefinite object leaves unfolding unspecified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the category of right guidance is named while its concrete form remains open.
topics.reason: The tanwīn marks indefiniteness, and the matching indefiniteness with {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}) keeps both alternatives formally open.

topics.headline: rectitude beyond mere information
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the desired outcome is mature right-directedness and a course to be taken up, not bare data.
topics.reason: The r-sh-d field supports rectitude, mature judgment, and proceeding rightly, locally opposed to {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}).

topics.headline: final word gives the positive pole last position
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not with ignorance itself but with the most relationally anchored possibility.
topics.reason: The final placement lets {{ar:رَشَدًۭا}} ({{tr:rashadā}}) answer initial {{ar:شَرٌّ}} ({{tr:sharrun}}) while preserving the question frame.

topics.headline: guidance thread across the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing term belongs to the surah’s continuing right-guidance thread (72:2, 72:14, 72:21).
topics.reason: The recurrence evidence links this final word with earlier and later r-sh-d uses, including the Lord-linked guidance language of 72:2.

topics.headline: prior obstruction becomes possible guidance question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior heavenly blockage can now be interpreted as potentially serving right direction.
topics.reason: The boundary evidence connects the previous sensory obstruction to the current question about intended right guidance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا ندري ... أشر أريد ... أم أراد ... ربهم رشدا
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages bounded knowledge around one earthly event. A passive harmful purpose is set against an active, relationally named lordly purpose of orientation, and the alternatives remain open.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness makes the opening negation an explicit epistemic limit.
Evil and badness supplies the negative pole whose intended agent is left unexpressed.
Will and intention binds both alternatives to purpose rather than mere outcome.
The lower ground opposite the sky locates the disputed purpose among earth's inhabitants.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identifies an agent only in the rushd alternative.
Right guidance on a straight course supplies the positive directional pole.

changed_reading.before: A generic question whether something bad or good will happen on earth.
changed_reading.after: A purpose-question under confessed ignorance: is an earthward change hostile in aim, or is their Lord deliberately reorienting its recipients?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive أريد is answered by the active أراد بهم ربهم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two clauses are semantically opposed but grammatically unequal. Harmful intention has no expressed agent, while repair-oriented intention is assigned to their Lord; this tilts attribution without resolving the question.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness defines the patient-side possibility in the passive clause.
The repeated will-and-intention image makes the change in voice and named agency diagnostic.
Repair, nurture, and completion gives the named lordly agency a constructive functional profile.
Sound judgment in handling an affair renders rushd as competent ordering, not only a pleasant result.

changed_reading.before: Two balanced possibilities with equal causal attribution.
changed_reading.after: An unresolved contrast with a marked asymmetry: harmful agency is withheld from expression, while constructive ordering is explicitly lordly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The newly guarded celestial listening route is blocked just as hidden knowledge arrives by revelation, is heard as Qur'an, and guides to rushd. The apparently hostile perimeter can therefore be read as rerouting from interception to authorized, action-guiding hearing.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness names the first appraisal of the new barrier.
Will and intention turns the barrier from a bare event into a question about its designed function.
Straight-course guidance supplies the candidate destination of the rerouting.
Auditory reception names the old celestial listening route that now meets a barrier.
Watching and guarding makes the obstruction an intentional perimeter rather than random noise.
A divine report or inspiration supplies the authorized channel that replaces illicit access.
Understanding and responsive hearing turns reception of Qur'an into a usable alternative to eavesdropping.
Gentle direction toward the road and truth gives the new channel a guiding function.
The explicit destination of straight guidance directly activates the focus ayah's rushd alternative.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 immediately precede the focus: heaven is newly full of guards and flames, and الآن marks a changed access regime.
72:1-2 reverses the channel: revelation is heard as Qur'an and explicitly guides to rushd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked listening route and a revealed hearing route whose stated result is rushd. I infer a functional arrow from prohibition to redirection. A live alternative is that the guard only punishes trespass and the Qur'an sequence is not its purpose.

changed_reading.before: The new celestial defenses are evidence that evil may be aimed at earth.
changed_reading.after: The defenses may be severe means within a guidance transition: closing one knowledge route so that hearers turn to revealed speech that actually yields rushd.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier conjectural universals proved unreliable; the focus replaces them with an explicit refusal to claim hidden purpose. The later parallel لا أدري construction and assignment of the unseen to divine knowledge make this restraint a learned form of rushd.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness makes لا ندري a deliberate boundary claim.
Sound judgment lets epistemic restraint itself participate in competent handling of the event.
Speech that runs as conjecture characterizes the earlier confidence about what humans and jinn would say.
Doubt and imagining supplies the weak epistemic basis that the focus no longer disguises as certainty.
The opposite of truth exposes why their prior universal trust required correction.
The repeated knowing construction extends confessed limitation from purpose to timing.
What is hidden from sight defines the domain they decline to decode.
Disclosure to the knower assigns full cognition elsewhere and legitimates limited creaturely claims.

structural_cues: 72:5 and 72:7 use ظن for sweeping claims; 72:10 shifts to لا ندري after those assumptions are exposed.
72:25 repeats إن أدري أ... أم... ربي, and 72:26 immediately names the knower of the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence from unreliable ظن to repeated لا أدري and then divine unseen-knowledge. I infer correction and maturation across that sequence. A live alternative is that each statement concerns a separate topic and carries no developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are merely confused about the meaning of one event.
changed_reading.after: Their non-knowledge is disciplined speech after failed assumptions: rushd includes knowing when not to attribute a hidden purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context divides the apparent collective into morally and directionally different paths, then attaches rushd to surrender and ruin to deviation. Evil and rushd need not be rival decrees for an undifferentiated earth; one intervention can disclose different trajectories through response.

activation_trace.role: Earth as the lower inhabited domain supplies the broad population whose apparent unity is later partitioned.
Evil and badness supplies one possible trajectory within the differentiated field.
Straight guidance supplies the alternative trajectory rather than a uniform collective outcome.
Soundness opposed to corruption marks one internal class among the speakers.
An extended route turns group difference into a plurality of courses.
Distinct paths and groups sharpens the partition instead of treating the community as one recipient.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies the responsive movement associated with seeking rushd.
Deviation and inclination from right supplies the opposed response trajectory.
Sound handling of an affair makes rushd something actively sought by one response class.

structural_cues: 72:11 twice says منا and then describes plural, partitioned paths.
72:14-15 converts the partition into response and consequence clauses: surrender seeks rushd, while deviation becomes fuel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal path-diversity followed by divergent responses and consequences. I infer that this unpacks the focus's broad earthly recipient phrase. A live alternative is that the later partition classifies only the jinn speakers and does not answer the wider earthward question.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks which single intention covers everyone on earth.
changed_reading.after: The question opens onto differentiated reception: a lordly intervention can yield rushd for those who seek its course and destructive consequence for those who depart from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A failed protection relation explicitly increases oppressive burden, while hearing guidance and trusting the Lord negates fear of deprivation and burden. The passive evil possibility can therefore include creature-amplified harm rather than requiring a directly named divine agent.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness is recast as an experienced condition that may arise through a social mechanism.
Will and intention keeps the question of ultimate purpose distinct from the proximate harm mechanism.
Repair and nurture makes the Lord relation the constructive alternative to misdirected refuge.
Sound handling supplies the changed conduct that interrupts the harmful loop.
Seeking refuge supplies the protective relation that misfires.
Increase and growth supplies the explicit escalation arrow in فزادوهم.
Overwhelming and overpowering names the burden produced by the refuge loop.
Understanding and responsive hearing initiates the contrasting relation to guidance.
Gentle direction to the road supplies the content that reorders conduct.
Settled security and trust supplies the new attachment to their Lord.
Diminution of right or measure defines one feared harm negated after faith.
A burdensome imposition is the repeated harm now denied as the believer's feared outcome.

structural_cues: 72:6 gives an explicit social causative sequence: people seek refuge from jinn, and the relation increases rahaq.
72:13 reverses the sequence: hearing guidance leads to faith, followed by no fear of bakhs or rahaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one creaturely feedback loop and one guidance-based reversal. I infer that the loop is a plausible proximate source for the focus's agentless evil. A live alternative is that the focus refers only to the celestial defenses and not to the refuge relation.

changed_reading.before: If evil is intended, it must be a simple top-down decree.
changed_reading.after: Some experienced evil may be an escalating product of misplaced refuge, while lordly rushd redirects dependence and ends fear of deprivation and oppressive burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger later denies ownership or disposal of both harm and rushd, while the Lord is named as the one who sets an endpoint. This sharpens the focus's active-passive asymmetry into a distinction between reporting outcomes and controlling purpose.

activation_trace.role: The repeated will-and-intention image foregrounds who can be credited with purposive control.
The evil pole remains reported without an expressed controller.
Lordship and authority makes the named controller of the rushd pole explicit.
Ownership and disposal is precisely the capacity the messenger denies possessing.
Harm and diminution supplies the later negative pole placed outside messenger control.
Straight guidance supplies the same positive pole, likewise denied as messenger-owned.
Causing a thing to take a state gives the Lord an active endpoint-setting function.
Lordship and authority identifies the one who can set that endpoint.

structural_cues: The focus moves from passive أريد to active أراد بهم ربهم.
72:21 denies the messenger control of both ضر and رشد; 72:25 names the Lord as maker of the term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voice asymmetry, messenger non-ownership, and later lordly endpoint-setting. I infer a control hierarchy linking them. A live alternative is that the passive in the focus is stylistic and carries no attributional weight.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks which outcome the speaker or messenger will bring about.
changed_reading.after: The speakers can report the polarity but cannot own it: harmful effect is left agentless, constructive purpose is named as lordly, and the messenger controls neither.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straightness on the path leads to abundant water, but that abundance is explicitly an assay; turning away leads into arduous punishment. Surface comfort and pain therefore do not by themselves identify the hidden intention. Rushd is an oriented way of handling the test.

activation_trace.role: Evil and badness supplies the valence category that cannot be read directly from surface comfort or severity.
Repair, nurture, and completion permits a constructive purpose to operate through testing rather than comfort alone.
Sound handling of an affair makes rushd the response capacity by which a condition is navigated.
Straightness and balanced alignment supplies the antecedent posture.
The extended path gives that posture a directional field continuous with focus rushd.
Making provision of drink supplies the apparently beneficial result.
Abundant water and provision intensifies the positive surface valence.
Assaying metal or a person reverses abundance from simple reward into a revealing test.
Penetrating along a route makes the opposed consequence another directed course.
Pain and punishment supplies the severe result attached to turning away.
An arduous ascent gives that result its sustained difficulty.

structural_cues: 72:16 conditions abundant water on straightness along the path.
72:17 begins لنفتنهم فيه, making the abundance itself the medium of testing, then contrasts turning away with arduous punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant abundance as test and hardship after a contrary response. I infer that experiential valence cannot decode the focus's hidden intent. A live alternative is that the test logic applies only to the water promise and should not govern the celestial event.

changed_reading.before: Rushd means a comfortable outcome, while evil means a painful one.
changed_reading.after: Rushd is right orientation within lordly testing; abundance can test and severity can follow misorientation, so felt valence alone cannot identify purpose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guarding root frames blocked celestial listening and protected messenger disclosure. The later sequence limits the unseen, grants an exception through a messenger, guards that route, and closes with total encompassing and enumeration. The focus's ignorance is a position inside governed disclosure, not random informational failure.

activation_trace.role: Knowing and awareness marks the precise capacity bounded by the disclosure architecture.
Sound judgment remains available as actionable orientation even when total causal knowledge is withheld.
Watching and guarding closes the listeners' former access route.
The parallel confession of non-knowledge extends bounded access to the messenger's knowledge of timing.
Concealment from sight defines the protected information domain.
Disclosure to the knower assigns complete access to the divine side of the boundary.
Emergence and disclosure names the controlled crossing from hidden to manifest.
Messenger and message supplies the authorized exception through which disclosure travels.
Inserting one thing into another makes the guard placement an engineered channel.
The repeated watching and guarding now protects authorized transmission before and behind.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and custody closes the system around the messengers.
Enumeration and exhaustive accounting makes the oversight fine-grained rather than approximate.

structural_cues: The exact root ر ص د occurs at 72:9 against would-be listeners and at 72:27 around an approved messenger.
72:25-28 moves from non-knowledge, to restriction of the unseen, to a messenger exception, to guarded delivery and complete oversight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored guards and an explicit hidden-to-messenger disclosure sequence. I infer one access-control architecture that explains the focus's limit. A live alternative is that the two guards serve unrelated security scenes and should not be unified functionally.

changed_reading.before: They lack enough evidence to guess what the event means.
changed_reading.after: They occupy an intentionally bounded epistemic tier: enough revealed guidance to act with rushd, but not enough unseen access to decode every event's purpose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from د ر ي to the form-distant د ر ر course/alignment branch rather than the ordinary knowing sense. It remains anchored to ندري and is reinforced by focus rushd plus later path and straightness language. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial activation, never as a lexical replacement for ندري.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ندري beside رشد allows missing knowledge to be re-imaged as missing alignment with a course.

activation_trace.role: Course, wind-direction, and alignment supplies the exploratory spatial image for their non-knowing.
Straight-course guidance gives the verse an explicit reorientation pole.
Extended paths make plural trajectories visible immediately after the focus.
Straightness and balanced alignment supplies the corrective posture within those trajectories.

changed_reading.before: Not knowing is only an absence of information.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also loss of alignment after a route-change, while rushd is recovery of a viable course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the seeking/scouting branch of the repeated ر و د rather than treating إرادة only as settled will. It stays anchored to both intent verbs and is materially prompted by the speakers' failed celestial reconnaissance. Downstream prose should qualify it as a process analogy, not translate أراد as scouted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired أريد / أراد can carry a secondary process image of seeking out a course after the speakers' own search is blocked.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and scouting supplies a dynamic process image beneath the repeated intention terms.
Knowing and awareness marks the failure to determine which purposive search governs the event.
Straight guidance supplies one candidate course being sought for earth.
Seeking and probing supplies the speakers' attempted celestial reconnaissance.
Sitting for surveillance makes their former listening practice a deliberate watch operation.
Counter-watching and guarding closes that reconnaissance and activates the question of a larger purpose.

changed_reading.before: Will is only a completed hidden decree behind the barrier.
changed_reading.after: As a contained process image, the verse asks which trajectory is now being sought for earth after the listeners' own scouting route has failed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the packet's non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و nurture/growth mapping with fertile earth, irrigation, abundance, and assay. The chain remains anchored to ربهم, الأرض, and رشد, but it is a cross-domain cultivation model. Downstream prose should mark it as exploratory material analogy rather than a direct gloss of رب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ربهم ... الأرض ... رشدا can be modeled as cultivation of earthbound recipients toward mature handling.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and growing up supplies the cultivation function for lordly intention.
Soft fertile ground supplies the growth medium for the earthbound recipients.
Sound judgment in handling affairs supplies the maturity that cultivation seeks.
Making irrigation or drink supplies the nurturing input.
Abundant water and provision supplies growth conditions in excess.
Assaying a material or person turns provision into a test of what the growth produces.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord intends to give an abstract directive called guidance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, lordly rushd is cultivation: earth is the medium, provision supplies growth, and testing reveals whether mature judgment forms.

strongest_changes: The hostile-looking celestial perimeter can function as redirection from intercepted hearing to revealed hearing that explicitly yields rushd.
لا ندري becomes disciplined epistemic conduct after failed conjecture and within a governed disclosure system.
Later path-diversity and abundance-as-test break the simple equations earth equals one recipient and rushd equals comfort.
summary.what_was_special: The exact رصد recurrence around blocked listeners and protected messengers, the parallel لا أدري alternatives in 72:10 and 72:25, and the straight-path-to-abundance-to-test sequence jointly changed the focus from a binary forecast into a question about channel, agency, response, and epistemic rank.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus may refer narrowly to the new celestial defenses or more broadly to an earthwide historical change.
The passive أريد leaves harmful agency unexpressed, but grammar alone cannot decide whether that withholding is theologically contrastive or stylistic.
The differentiated paths explicitly classify the jinn speakers; extending that partition to everyone in the focus's earth phrase remains abductive.
The course-alignment and cultivation readings depend on supplied split-root branches and should remain exploratory images.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Observed obstruction underdetermines its purpose.** `ندري` activates د ر ي B001, knowing; both forms of `أريد/أراد` activate ر و د B001, will and intention; `شر` activates ش ر ر B001, evil; `ربهم` activates ر ب ب B001-B002, authority and nurture; and `رشدا` activates ر ش د B001-B002, right course and sound management. The balanced question opposes passive “evil was intended” to active “their Lord intended sound judgment.” The abductive move is that the same guarded-sky event can support opposed causal models until purpose is disclosed. The ayah reads as disciplined uncertainty rather than fear-driven interpretation.

2. **Flame-signs can look like evil while serving guidance.** Dormant ش ر ر B003 is “flying sparks of fire,” activated by `شهب` in 72:8-9, while `الأرض` activates ء ر ض B001, the lower ground opposite the sky. The packet supplies sparks above and observers below; the inferred move is that material signs of burning can be misclassified as intended harm. The ayah therefore makes the evil/guidance contrast perceptual as well as moral: the appearance of fiery exclusion does not settle its terrestrial aim.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The provision-and-trial sequence in 72:16-17 demonstrates how one act can serve guidance without looking simply pleasant. The speaker’s continued uncertainty about timing in 72:25, followed by divine hidden knowledge in 72:26, also validates the restraint of `لا ندري`.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Disciplined uncertainty replaces contagious certainty.** Fixed `د ر ي` B001 is knowing and awareness. Its explicit negation follows the duplicated certainties of `ظَنَنَّا` and `ظَنُّوا ... ظَنَنتُمْ` (72:5, 7; `ظ ن ن` B001/B003) and follows a real but underdetermined observation in 72:8-9. The packet supplies prior assumptions, new evidence, and a refusal to overread it; I infer that `لَا نَدْرِى` is an epistemic correction produced by the encounter. The statement reads as learned restraint, not mere ignorance.

2. **A fiery sign does not settle whether evil is intended.** Fixed `ش ر ر` B001 is evil/badness, but B003 is flying sparks of fire; the immediately preceding fixed `شِهَابًا` (`ش ه ب` B002) supplies the bright firebrand that makes the branch image salient. The speakers can observe the hazardous spark but still ask `أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ`. The packet supplies sensory fire and a separate moral branch; I infer that material adversity is not sufficient evidence of harmful purpose. `أَشَرٌّ` reads as a hypothesis consciously withheld from the visible sign.

3. **The voice asymmetry separates an unknown event from a named formative agent.** The first fixed `ر و د` appears as passive `أُرِيدَ` with no expressed agent; the second is active `أَرَادَ ... رَبُّهُمْ`. `ر و د` B001 supplies will and intention, while fixed `ر ب ب` B002 supplies stage-by-stage nurture and repair, and `ر ش د` B001/B002 supplies right course and sound judgment. The packet supplies the grammatical asymmetry and the branch bundle; I infer that the positive alternative can be modeled causally as a nurturer intentionally redirecting conduct, whereas the proposed evil remains unattributed. The verse reads as asymmetric causal caution rather than a balanced guess between equivalent agents.

4. **A change above may be routing those below.** Fixed `ء ر ض` B001 is the lower ground opposite the sky. The problem observed in the sky (72:8-9) is explicitly considered in relation to `مَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ`, and the next ayat move from multiple divided paths (72:11) to recognition of inescapability, faithful hearing, and searching out `رَشَدًا` (72:12-14). The packet supplies the vertical relation and the later behavioral sequence; I infer that blocking one upper route may redirect agents on the lower plane. `بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ` reads as the target field of an access change whose effect is moral navigation.

5. **Guidance remains a practical outcome, not just benevolent intent.** Fixed `ر ش د` B002 is sound judgment in managing an affair. Within the forward half-window, 72:11 names divided courses, 72:12 abandons escape as a viable strategy, and 72:13-14 links hearing and surrender to freedom from loss/overburden and deliberate pursuit of right course. The packet supplies proposed intention and subsequent practical reorganization; I infer that the hypothesis `رَشَدًا` predicts observable correction. The final noun reads as a testable direction of effects.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:25 repeats the fixed `د ر ي` B001 construction under `قُلْ`, showing that calibrated uncertainty persists even for the commissioned speaker when timing is inaccessible. Then 72:26 names the unseen's knower and 72:27 its approved disclosure route. Those later ayat confirm the fixed refusal to infer intention from a fiery sign: observed effects, hidden purpose, and authorized knowledge remain distinct fields.

baseline.text: Yeryüzündekilere kötülük mü istendi, yoksa Rableri onlar için doğruluk mu istedi, bilmiyoruz.

findings.text: Gerçek bir değişikliği gördükten sonra amacı bildiğini ileri sürmemek, önceki bulaşıcı kesinliğin yerini alan disiplinli bir bilgi tutumudur.
Önceki ayetlerdeki ateşli işaret, görünüşte zarar verici olsa da yeryüzü için kötü bir amaç bulunduğunu tek başına kanıtlamaz.
Kötülük olasılığının faili belirtilmezken doğru yön etkin biçimde Rabbe bağlanır; olumlu seçenek, yetiştirici bir yönlendirme modeli sunar.
Gökte bir erişim yolunun kapatılması, aşağıdaki insanların ve cinlerin davranış güzergâhını yeniden düzenlemeyi amaçlayan bir yönlendirme olabilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Concealed Dispatch Becomes Epistemic Commitment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A message moves through controlled stages from hidden transmission to audible form, understanding, and committed response; failure occurs when speech detaches from that chain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The lexical network treats revelation less as a static text than as a custody chain whose successive operations can be contrasted with the uncontrolled manufacture and circulation of claims.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Assumption is forced back into acknowledged uncertainty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Strong belief, weak surmise, suspicion, and unreliable expectation are distinguished until the speakers explicitly admit that another's intended outcome remains unknown.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: conviction inferred from an indicator (`quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`); weak surmise (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); accusation and suspicion (`quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`); habitual mistrust (`quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`); an outcome that cannot be relied upon (`quranic:root_000969:B006/m01`); knowledge and making known (`quranic:root_000473:B001/m01`); intention and volition (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); evil or harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000787:B001/m01`); rectifying direction (`quranic:root_000565:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The same root can name conviction, conjecture, accusation, or an expectation whose end is insecure. The scene therefore sorts epistemic states rather than treating all belief alike. At 72:10 the sorting terminates in a disciplined admission: the observed closure of the sky does not disclose whether harm or rectification is intended.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed sitting place (`quranic:root_001244:B001/m01`); sitting in surveillance (`quranic:root_001244:B005/m01`); auditory capture (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); the ear as receiving aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); watch and ambush (`quranic:root_000566:B001/m01`); prepared allocation (`quranic:root_000566:B002/m01`); a designated watch-place or trap (`quranic:root_000566:B003/m01`); hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); set trap (`quranic:root_000932:B013/m01`); stalking behind cover (`quranic:root_000473:B003/m01`); defensive screen (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A bright projectile performs the interception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The defended post launches a brilliant moving flame with the force of a combatant or charge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: brilliant flame or falling meteor (`quranic:root_000821:B002/m01`); warrior advancing in battle (`quranic:root_000821:B003/m01`); mixed light and darkness on the projectile (`quranic:root_000821:B001/m01`); flying sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); cutting and scattering under impact (`quranic:root_000787:B004/m01`); a forceful charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); a group rising to battle (`quranic:root_001532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interceptor combines optical, thermal, and martial roles. Its mixed brightness gives it visible form, sparks supply dispersing fragments, and charge and warrior imagery give it directed agency. The flame is therefore not scenery around the guard system but the system's moving strike.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A Community Is Sorted into Cuts, Tracks, and Measured Alignment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective difference is materialized as longitudinal cuts and traversable tracks, then evaluated by whether a course is straight, balanced, or structurally warped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social and moral differentiation becomes a fabrication process: material is cut into strips, laid as routes, checked against a straight measure, and rejected as crooked dry stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deviant structure becomes dry combustible stock
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A course that bends away from the true line is embodied as warped or desiccated limbs and finally assigned the role of gathered fuel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deviation from the equitable line (`quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`); bent or rigid legs (`quranic:root_001224:B005/m01`); constricted provision (`quranic:root_001224:B010/m01`); gathered firewood (`quranic:root_000335:B001/m01`); a body dried like timber (`quranic:root_000335:B004/m01`); airborne sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); a white barren season (`quranic:root_000821:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The q-s-t contrast moves from moral deviation to bodily geometry: the line is bent, the limbs stiffen, provision contracts, and the result resembles dry timber. Firewood then ceases to be an arbitrary punishment image; it is the material endpoint of a warped and desiccated course.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sütün memeden, yağmurun buluttan ve başka sıvıların kendi kaynağından bolca çıkmasını ortak çekirdek olarak destekler. Bunun yanında gelir ve pazar bolluğu, övgü-yergi kalıpları ve dişi keçinin erkeği istemesi gibi kullanımlar da vardır; bunlar doğrudan sıvı akışıymış gibi genellenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir kaynağın bol ürün vermesidir; kalıplaşmış övgü, yergi ve bolluk anlatımları ayrı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak akış çekirdeği ile süt, yağmur ve gözyaşı kullanımları; övgü, yergi, pazar ve gelir kalıplarından ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kaynaktan süt, yağmur, gözyaşı ya da benzeri bir ürünün bolca çıkması veya kaynağın bunu bolca vermesidir. Bu çekirdek, gelir ve pazarın artması gibi bolluk anlatımlarına ve yalnız belirli söz kalıplarında görülen övgü, yergi ve çiftleşme isteği kullanımlarına uzanır.

facets.statement: Sıvı veya ürün, kendi doğal kaynağından bolca çıkar ya da akar.
Süt verme ve bulutun bol yağmur bırakması, çekirdeğin başlıca somut gerçekleşmeleridir.
Vergi gelirinin çoğalması ve pazarın canlanması, bol ürün verme düşüncesinin soyut uzantılarıdır.
Övgü ve yergi sözleri ile dişi keçinin erkeği istemesi yalnız kendi kalıplarında geçerli bağlantılı kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik tanıklık, süt ve yağmur başta olmak üzere kaynaktan bol çıkışı; buradan gelişen gelir, pazar, övgü-yergi ve çiftleşme isteği kullanımlarıyla birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi at veya başka bir binek hayvanının şiddetli, hızlı ve aynı zamanda rahat koşmasını açıkça destekler. Atın belirli yürüyüşünde ön ayağı kaldırıp indirmesi de tanıklanır; bu nedenle kol genel hız değil, hayvan koşusu ve ona bağlı yürüyüş biçimiyle sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, özellikle at ve binek hayvanının hızlı koşusudur; her türlü hızlı hareketi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hızlı ve akıcı hayvan koşusu çekirdeği korunur; bacak gücü ve atın özel ayak hareketi yalnız kendi bağlamlarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Atın veya başka bir binek hayvanının güçlü, hızlı ve akıcı biçimde koşmasıdır. Bazı kullanımlar koşma gücünü, bazılarıysa atın belirli yürüyüşünde ön ayağını kaldırıp indirmesini özellikle belirtir.

facets.statement: Binek hayvanı güçlü, hızlı ve akıcı bir koşu gerçekleştirir.
Koşmayı sağlayan bacak gücü, belirli bir söz kalıbında ayrıca vurgulanır.
Atın tırıs benzeri yürüyüşünde ön ayağını kaldırıp indirmesi, koşu alanına bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik tanıklık, hızlı ve rahat hayvan koşusunu; koşma gücü ve atın belirli ayak hareketiyle ilgili daha dar kullanımlarla birlikte verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gevşek etin sallanmasını ve çocuğun bir şeyi ağzında çevirip çiğnemesini hareket çekirdeğiyle birleştirir; diş yuvaları, dil ucu, dişsizlik ve gereksiz gidip gelme kullanımlarını da aynı kol içinde verir. Geçici çerçeve ağız ve et alanını iyi yakalar, ancak gereksiz gidip gelme uzantısını ve durağan beden adlarını ayrıca belirtmek gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sallanma ve tekrarlı hareket çekirdektir; diş yuvası gibi beden adları ile amaçsız gidip gelme ayrı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kol çıplak biçimde tanıklanır; tanım hem hareket çekirdeğini hem de kaynakta verilen beden adı ve amaçsız dolaşma uzantılarını sınırlarıyla korur.

concept_map.definition: Temel hareket imgesi, gevşek bir parçanın sallanıp oynaması veya bir şeyin tekrar tekrar gidip gelmesidir. Ağız alanında bu imge diş yuvalarının adı, çocuğun bir şeyi ağzında çevirip çiğnemesi ve dişler düşünce yuvaların görünmesi gibi özel kullanımlara uzanır.

facets.statement: Gevşek bir parça sallanır, oynar veya tekrar tekrar gidip gelir.
Diş yuvaları ve kimi aktarımda dil ucu, hareket imgesiyle bağlantılı beden adlarıdır.
Çocuğun bir şeyi ağzında çevirip çiğnemesi, hareket çekirdeğinin ağız içindeki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Dişlerin dökülmesiyle yuvaların görünmesi, beden adı kullanımına bağlı bir durumdur.
Bir kimsenin gereksiz yere gidip gelmesi, tekrarlı hareketin davranış alanındaki uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik tanıklık; sallanan et, diş yuvaları, ağızda çevirip çiğneme, dişsizlik ve gereksiz gidip gelme kullanımlarını hareket ve ağız alanları çevresinde toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin temel adlandırması beyazlık veya parlaklık niteliği değil, büyük inciler ya da tek bir incidir. Parlak ve ışığı güçlü yıldız kullanımı, yıldızın beyazlığı ve ışığı bakımından inciye benzetilmesine dayanır; bu yüzden nitelik, nesne çekirdeğinin yerine geçirilmeden uzantı olarak kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek inci veya iri incidir; beyaz ve güçlü ışıklı yıldız yalnız inci benzetmesine dayanan özel bir uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: İnci adı çıplak çekirdektir; parlak yıldız anlamı yalnız tanıklanan yıldız tamlaması içinde, inci benzetmesine bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnciyi, özellikle iri ve değerli inciyi adlandırır. Belirli bir yıldız anlatımında, beyazlığı ve güçlü ışığı nedeniyle inciye benzetilen parlak yıldızı niteler.

facets.statement: Nesne olarak inci veya inciler adlandırılır.

Beyaz ve güçlü ışıklı yıldız, inciye benzetilerek kurulan özel bir adlandırmadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi vurmak için kullanılan bilinen bir aracı ve özellikle yöneticinin bu amaçla kullandığı değneği açıkça adlandırır. Hazırlanan çerçeve, inci veya süt bolluğu anlamlarıyla karıştırmadan bu araç kimliğini doğru biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dönen suyu ve denizde suyun kabarıp çalkalandığı, gemilerin çoğu kez kurtulamadığı tehlikeli yeri birlikte tanımlar. Hazırlanan çerçeve hem dönme hareketini hem de boğulma ve gemi tehlikesini doğru biçimde korur.

error_profile.preserves: Girdap hareketini, deniz sınırını ve tehlike özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Su hareketinin görünüşünün açıklandığı, yer ve sonucu ikincil kalan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suyun dönmesi, kabarması ve çalkalanması özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Denizdeki yerleşik bölgeyi ve gemi için doğan ağır tehlikeyi açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: girdap; gemiyi tehlikeye atan çalkantılı deniz yeri

error_profile.preserves: Suyun kabarıp hareket etmesi görünüşünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendi çevresinde dönüşü, yerelleşmiş girdabı ve batma tehlikesini siler.
error_profile.adds: İlerleyen veya rüzgârla yükselen sıradan su sırtlarını kapsar.
error_profile.collision: İlerleyen dalga ile yerinde dönen girdap birbirine karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Olayın gerçekleştiği genel su alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Dönme, kabarma ve gemiyi tehdit eden yerel hareketi belirtmez.
error_profile.adds: Sakin ve tehlikesiz bölümler dahil bütün geniş tuzlu su alanını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Su kendi çevresinde döner ve yerelleşmiş bir batma tehlikesi oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Rüzgârın su yüzeyinde yükselttiği tabakalar veya ilerleyen dalga görünümü öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da deniz yüzeyindeki güçlü ve görünür su hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun hareketi dönerek aynı bölgede tehlike yaratır; komşunun hareketi rüzgârla yükselen ya da ilerleyen dalga ve su tabakalarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yerel dönme hareketi ve geminin kurtulamama tehlikesi kurucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Denizin derin, geniş ve dalgalı ana bölümü ile geminin orada ilerlemesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Çalkantılı deniz suyu ve geminin tehlikeli sularda bulunması alanında kesişirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol belirli bir girdap noktasını adlandırır; komşu ise dönme koşulu aramadan denizin derin ve geniş, dalgaları hareketli bölümünü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Su dönüp kabarır ve gemi için ciddi tehlike oluşturacak ölçüde hareketlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su, rüzgâr veya gemi hareketten sonra durulup yerinde kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol aynı su ve gemi alanında hareket derecesinin karşıt uçlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yoğun dönme ve çalkantıyla tanımlanırken komşu, hareketin kesilip suyun veya geminin durulmasıyla tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tehlike, suyun yerel ve dairesel hareketinden doğar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su yükselip taşarak önündekileri sürükleyen doğrusal ve yaygın bir güç gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Güçlü su hareketinin insan veya gemi için oluşturduğu tehlikede kesişirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol yerel dönme ve girdap hareketidir; komşuysa yükselen suyun taşması ve önündekileri alıp götüren genişleyici gücüyle belirlenir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dalga, açık deniz çalkantısı, durgunluk karşıtı ve sürükleyici taşkınla sınırı gösteren dört aday seçildi. Diğerleri yalnız deniz ortamını paylaşır veya aynı kökün ayrı anlamlarıdır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, bolca dışarı çıkma ve hızlı koşma gibi hareket anlamlarının yanında ağız çevresi hareketi, yön ve hizalanma, inci, vurma değneği, iğ döndürme ve deniz girdabı gibi belirgin biçimde ayrılan sekiz anlam kolu taşır. Bazı kollarda hareket veya bolluk çağrışımı sezilse de bütün kolları tek bir üretken çekirdeğe indirgemek doğru değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi bilme ile onu başkasına bildirme ettirgenliğini birlikte verir; ayrıca bazı kullanımlarda bilginin zihinsel ustalıkla edinildiğini belirtir. Hazırlanmış çerçeve bu bileşenleri aynı anlam alanında doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal temel bilme, ustalıkla kavrama ve bildirme anlamlarıyla sınırlıdır; saldırı amacıyla yönelme, avda gizlenme ve sivri uç anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak bilme anlamı ile ettirgen bildirme, adlaşmış kavrayış ve kalıplaşmış söyleyişler ayrı tutulur; kalıba bağlı bir kullanım kökün bütün anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek ve ona dair kavrayış edinmek, ayrıca bir başkasının da o şeyi bilmesini sağlamaktır. Bilginin düşünsel ustalık veya ince bir yol bularak edinilmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Özne bir şeyi öğrenir, bilir veya onun hakkında kavrayış sahibi olur.
Ettirgen kullanımda özne, başka birinin söz konusu şeyi bilmesini sağlar.
Bazı kullanımlarda bilgi, düşünsel ustalık, incelik veya bir yol bulma sonucunda edinilen kavrayıştır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıkların ortak çekirdeği bir şeyi bilme ve başkasına bildirmedir. Toplu ifade, bilginin yalın öğrenmeden düşünsel ustalıkla edinilen kavrayışa kadar uzanabildiğini de gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi bilme, ustalıkla kavrama ve başkasına bildirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yalın bilme çekirdeğini, özel kavrayış biçimini ve ettirgen bildirme yönünü birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilme, ustalıkla kavrama ve başkasını bilgilendirme bileşenlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin bir şey hakkında bilgi sahibi olduğu, ettirgenlik veya özel bir edinme yolu belirtilmeyen cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şey hakkında bilgi sahibi olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasını bilgilendirme ve bilgiyi düşünsel ustalıkla edinme yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin sahip olduğu bilgiyi başka birine aktararak onun da bilmesini sağladığı ettirgen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başka birinin bir şeyi bilmesini sağlama yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Öznenin kendi bilme durumu ile düşünsel ustalıkla edinilen kavrayışı belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin ince düşünme, beceri veya dolaylı bir yol bulma sonucunda elde edildiği özel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin düşünsel ustalıkla edinilen kavrayış niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalın bilme kapsamını ve başkasını bilgilendiren ettirgen kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi bilmek veya ondan haberdar olmak
bilgi ve kavrayış; özellikle düşünsel ustalıkla edinilen bilgi

error_profile.preserves: Ustalık ve güçlü kavrayış çağrışımını kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalın bilme ile başkasını bilgilendirme işlevlerini karşılamaz.
error_profile.adds: Türkçedeki yerleşik kullanımında yeterlilik, dayanıklılık ve ileri görüşlülük çağrışımları ekler.
error_profile.collision: Yerleşik Türkçe anlamı, dalın geniş bilme ve bildirme yapısıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başkasını bilgilendiren ettirgen kullanımı ve kimi bağlamlarda düşünsel ustalıkla edinilen bilgiyi de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, anlamları doğrulama, akılla kavrama ve çabuk anlama yönlerini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şey hakkında bilgi ve kavrayış sahibi olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilmeden bildirmeye uzanan bir katılımcı değişimini barındırır; komşu ise bilginin akılla kavranması ve doğrulanması üzerinde yoğunlaşır. Bu nedenle yalnız bilme bağlamında yaklaşırlar, bütün sınırlarında birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, çağrı veya ilan gerektirmeden bir şeyi bilme ve bir başkasına bildirme anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, seslenme, ilan etme ve çağrının ulaştığı yer gibi duyurma araçlarını ve sonuçlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bilgi sahibi olma ve bilgiyi başkasına ulaştırma alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın bildirmesi genel bir ettirgen bilgi aktarımıdır; komşu dalda duyuru, çağrı ve bunlara bağlı roller kurucu kapsam kazanır. Araç ve olay yapısı bakımından sınırları ayrıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, önceden bir iz veya belirti bulunmasını gerektirmeden bilme ve bildirme anlamını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iz ya da belirti üzerinden tanıma, ayırt etme, karşılıklı tanışma ve araştırarak öğrenme süreçlerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bilgi edinme ve bir şeyi bilinir kılma sonucuna ulaşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bilgi ve kavrayış eksenindedir; komşunun çekirdeğinde bir izden tanıma ve ayırt etme işlemi vardır. Sonuçları benzeşse de bilgiye ulaşma koşulları aynı değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün adaylar, aynı kökün diğer dalları dahil, bilme, bildirme, tanıma, haber aktarma ve öteki bağımsız anlamlar bakımından karşılaştırıldı. Okurun sınırı en kolay karıştırabileceği üç bilgi dalı seçildi; kalanlar ya daha uzak bir alanı paylaşır ya da ek bir ayrım sağlamadan bu karşıtlıkları tekrarlar.
branches.what_is_ar: العلم بالشيء والدراية به وإعلام غيره به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس دفع الشيء ولا العوج ولا المدارأة المهموزة
branches.source_phrase_ar: دريت الشيء والله أدرانيه (maqayis)؛ درى يدري درية ودريا ودريانا ودراية (ayn)؛ دريته ودريت به أي علمت به وأدريته أي أعلمته (sihah)؛ أتى فلان الأمر من غير درية أي من غير علم (tahdhib)؛ الدراية المعرفة المدركة بضرب من الحيل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi isteyerek amaç edinme çekirdeğini belirli bir yer veya topluluğu baskın ya da saldırı için seçme kullanımıyla açıklar. Ancak mekanik collocation profili nedeniyle hazırlanan çerçeve, genel amaç edinmeyi dal anlamı saymayıp yalnız baskın veya saldırı için hedef seçme yapısını koruyacak biçimde daraltılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız sunulan saldırı veya baskın kalıbında geçerlidir; genel amaç edinme, fiziksel yönelme ya da her türlü saldırı anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bu dal yalnız belirli bir yer ya da kişiyi baskın veya saldırı amacıyla seçen yapıya bağlıdır; buradan çıplak kök için genel bir yönelme anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yer ya da kişiyi, üzerine baskın veya saldırı düzenlemek üzere bilinçli biçimde amaç edinip seçmektir. Anlam, genel yönelmeyi değil saldırı niyeti taşıyan bu özel yapıyı bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir yer veya kişi bilinçli biçimde amaç edinilir ve eylemin yöneltileceği taraf olarak seçilir.
Amaç edinme, özellikle baskın veya saldırı düzenleme niyetine bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, amaçlı seçme çekirdeğini bir yerin veya topluluğun baskın ve saldırı için hedeflenmesiyle somutlaştırır. Bu savaş bağlamı, genel amaç edinme anlamını özel bir yapıda sınırlar.

concept_gloss.text: saldırı amacıyla bir yer ya da kişiyi seçmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir yerin veya kişinin baskın ya da saldırı niyetiyle amaç edinildiği kalıbın tam karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinçli seçim, yöneltilen taraf ve saldırı amacı bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Amaç edinilen tarafın bir yer olduğu ve yapılacak eylemin baskın olarak belirtildiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yer seçimini ve baskın amacını açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Amaç edinilen tarafın kişi veya topluluk olabilmesi ile daha genel saldırı seçeneğini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yere veya topluluğa karşı saldırı niyeti bulunduğunu akıcı biçimde açıklamak gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir tarafa yönelik saldırı niyetini korur.
error_profile.adds: Fiili hareketin başlayacağı veya kara üzerinden ilerleme olacağı izlenimini ekleyebilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir yeri baskın veya saldırı için seçmek

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir tarafa dönük olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Saldırı niyeti bulunmayan hareket, ilgi veya amaç bağlamlarını da kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel hareket ve amaç fiilleriyle karışarak yapının savaş bağlamındaki sınırını siler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız bir yer veya kişiyi baskın ya da saldırı için seçen yapıya bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel amaç edinme, bilinçli yönelme ve ok ya da mızrağı belirli bir kişiye doğrultma kullanımlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da belirli bir tarafın isteyerek seçilmesi ve eylemin ona yöneltilmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel ve araçtan bağımsız bir amaç edinme çekirdeğine sahiptir. Odak dal ise bu çekirdeği baskın veya saldırı niyeti taşıyan belirli bir yapıya daraltır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın kurucu öğesi saldırı amacıyla seçim ve niyettir; gerçek bir hareketin başlaması gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeye doğru yönelme, ona gitme ve onu zihinde tutma gibi daha genel süreçleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da eylemin belirli bir tarafa yönelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hedef seçimi ile saldırı niyetini birlikte gerektirir. Komşu dalda yönelme nötr olabilir ve fiili hareketi de içerebilir; bu yüzden sıradan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal saldırıdan önce yer veya kişi seçme ve ona yönelme niyetini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal atlı rakiplerin birbirini kovalaması, karşılıklı saldırması ve savaşta yanıltıcı geri çekilme yapmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal savaş ve saldırı sahnesinde yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnız savaş sahnesidir. Odak dal amaç ve hedef belirleme aşamasını, komşu ise çatışma içindeki takip ve manevra olayını adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar genel amaç edinme, yönelme, arama, savaş hareketi ve aynı kökün bağımsız dalları bakımından değerlendirildi. Seçilen üç komşu, özel saldırı yapısını genel amaç, genel yöneliş ve gerçekleşen savaş hareketinden ayırır; ötekiler bu sınırları daha az doğrudan gösterir.
